fields.Name: AIUsageByModel
fields.UserQuestion: What is the efficiency, cost, token distribution, and latency for each AI model and vendor?
fields.Description: Per vendor and model (and currency): model-call count, priced/unpriced run counts, own cost, prompt/completion tokens, median and 95th-percentile latency, and cache efficiency percentage.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Aggregates vwAIUsageFacts by VendorID, ModelID and CostCurrency over model calls only (parallel parents excluded). Optional start/end filter the base RunAt column. OwnCost sums priced runs only, with PricedRuns/UnpricedRuns beside it. LatencyP50/P95 are PERCENTILE_CONT window functions collapsed with MAX (SQL Server 2019+). CacheEfficiencyPct = TokensCacheRead * 100 / (TokensPrompt + TokensCacheRead), with both addends COALESCEd.

fields.Name: start
fields.Description: Optional start date for filtering AI usage runs. Guarded by truthiness check — empty string or null will cause this clause to be skipped.

fields.Name: end
fields.Description: Optional end date for filtering AI usage runs. Guarded by truthiness check — empty string or null will cause this clause to be skipped.

fields.Name: VendorID
fields.Description: The identifier of the AI vendor (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic)

fields.Name: ModelID
fields.Description: The identifier of the specific AI model used

fields.Name: CostCurrency
fields.Description: The currency code used for pricing/cost tracking

fields.Name: Runs
fields.Description: Total number of model execution runs
fields.ComputationDescription: COUNT(*) counting all matching execution rows

fields.Name: PricedRuns
fields.Description: Number of runs that have a known cost
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN x.IsPriced = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: UnpricedRuns
fields.Description: Number of runs that do not have a known cost
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN x.IsPriced = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: OwnCost
fields.Description: Total cost accumulated by priced runs
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN x.IsPriced = 1 THEN x.OwnCost ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: LatencyP50
fields.Description: The 50th percentile (median) execution latency in milliseconds
fields.ComputationDescription: MAX(x.LatencyP50) where LatencyP50 is calculated using PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.ExecutionTimeMS) OVER (PARTITION BY ...)

fields.Name: LatencyP95
fields.Description: The 95th percentile execution latency in milliseconds
fields.ComputationDescription: MAX(x.LatencyP95) where LatencyP95 is calculated using PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.ExecutionTimeMS) OVER (PARTITION BY ...)

fields.Name: CacheEfficiencyPct
fields.Description: Percentage of prompt tokens served from cache
